description: This file defines the class PermissionSubjectsMap, a specialized data structure implementing a weighted relation between permissions and subjects. It includes methods for managing, analyzing, and modifying permission-subject relationships within an authorization context.

classes.name: PermissionSubjectsMap
classes.description: A final class representing a weighted binary relation between permissions and subjects, extending AbstractMap and encapsulating logic for relation manipulation and querying.

methods.name: PermissionSubjectsMap
methods.description: Constructor initializing the internal data map.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Overrides AbstractMap.entrySet() to return set of permission-to-subjects entries.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates a permission with a map of subjects and their weights.

methods.name: addTotalRelationOfWeightZero
methods.description: Augments the relation with a total binary relation between given permissions and subject IDs, assigning weight zero.

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissions
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight among related permission-subject pairs for given permissions and subjects, if any; otherwise empty.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissions
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight over all relevant pairs only if all permissions relate to some subject IDs; otherwise empty.

methods.name: getSubjectUnion
methods.description: Returns a map representing the union (max weights) of subjects related to any given permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectIntersect
methods.description: Returns a map of subjects related to all given permissions, combining maximum weights.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this relation.

methods.name: copyWithIncrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy where each pair's weight is incremented by 1.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy where each pair's weight is decremented by 1.

methods.name: removeAllEntriesFrom
methods.description: Removes entries present in another relation from this relation.

methods.name: addPermissionSubjects
methods.description: Internal method to add permission with associated subjects to the relation, updating maximum weights.

methods.name: addAllEntriesFrom
methods.description: Merges another relation into this one, taking maximum weights for overlapping pairs.
